fields.description: Issue includes political commentary on the May 1927 Miami municipal election and calls for civic change, naming favored city commission candidates (including E. G. Sewell, Cliff Reeder, and others). Coverage also touches on Prohibition enforcement and federal court proceedings, Miami Beach policing and ordinances, local humor columns ("Little Geraldine"), Mother’s Day reflections, and promotional/real-estate news including Coral Gables home-building activity and local entertainment and advertising.
